Name: Better Stacking
Author: Tara864
Description:
Better Stacking
This mod allow items of different qualities to be stacked together in a single inventory slot while preserving their original qualities.
[heading]Features[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]Quality Stacking:[/b] Combines different qualities of the same item into one stack without changing their original quality.[/*]
[*][b]Original Item Appearance:[/b] Combined stacks retain the item's original icon and display the total quantity without a quality star.[/*]
[*][b]Right-Click Splitting:[/b] Right-click a combined stack to take out individual items while preserving their original qualities.[/*]
[*][b]Inventory Organization:[/b] Use the inventory's organize button to combine compatible items.[/*]
[*][b]Chest and Fridge Support:[/b] Compatible items can also be combined in chests and refrigerators.[/*]
[*][b]Automatic Merging:[/b] Compatible items can be merged when transferring them between your inventory and storage.[/*]
[*][b]Item Compatibility:[/b] Supports various item types, including crops, fish, flowers, and artisan goods.[/*]
[*][b]Dehydrator Support:[/b] Allows the Dehydrator to use five mushrooms or fruits of mixed qualities instead of requiring five of the same quality. The five lowest-value items are consumed first, and the resulting dried product has regular quality.[/*]
[*][b]Item Usage:[/b] Combined items can still be sold, eaten, and used in supported crafting and processing interactions.[/*]
[*][b]Tooltip Information:[/b] Hover over a combined stack to view information about its contents, including the different qualities and quantities.[/*]
[*][b]Configurable Auto-Merging:[/b] Enable or disable automatic item merging in the mod settings. You can still manually merge items using the Organize button when auto-merging is disabled.
[/*]
[/list][heading]How to Use[/heading]
Click the [b]Organize[/b] button in your inventory or chest to automatically combine compatible items of different qualities into a single stack.
For example, 5 regular blueberries, 5 silver blueberries, and 5 gold blueberries will be combined into one stack of 15 blueberries, with their original qualities preserved.
[list]
[*]Hover over a combined stack to see how many items of each quality it contains.[/*]
[*][b]Left-click[/b] a quality in the tooltip to withdraw items of that specific quality.[/*]
[*][b]Right-click[/b] to withdraw items using the normal Stardew Valley controls.[/*]
[*]Use the [b]mouse wheel[/b] to scroll through the tooltip when needed.[/*]
[/list][heading]Notes[/heading]
This is my first Stardew Valley mod, and it is still in beta. Some bugs or compatibility issues may occur.
Multiplayer and macOS compatibility have not been fully tested.
If you encounter any issues or have suggestions, feel free to leave a comment.
